lines.zh: 我几乎不动，只在水底挪一点。
lines.en: I barely move, only shifting along the seabed.

lines.zh: 棺材拖着我，一路压出沟。
lines.en: The coffin drags me, gouging a furrow.

lines.zh: 深海里没光，我照样看得见。
lines.en: No light in the deep, yet I see.
I shift position and keep watch again.

lines.zh: 我的袍子在水里散开，像雾。
lines.en: My robe unfurls in the water like mist.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟往前蹭了一小段。
lines.en: I inch forward along the trench a little.

lines.zh: 水压再大，也压不扁棺材。
lines.en: However heavy the water, the coffin won't crush.

lines.zh: 我挪动时，沙慢慢浮起来。
lines.en: When I shift, sand lifts slowly.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我等人来找我。
lines.en: I don't chase; I wait to be found.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的影子里滑过。
lines.en: I slide past the shadow of a wreck.

lines.zh: 我一步的距离，够走很久。
lines.en: One step of mine takes a long while.

lines.zh: 我往深处再挪些，那里更静。
lines.en: I shift deeper; it's quieter there.

lines.zh: 我的手指在沙上留下五道痕。
lines.en: My fingers leave five lines in the sand.
I drag the coffin and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着石壁走，脚不落地。
lines.en: I move along the rock wall without touching ground.
The surface is far; I needn't go up.
I halt, the coffin lid half open.

lines.zh: 笼子里的东西在动，我按住。
lines.en: The thing in the cage stirs; I hold it down.
I'm counting who will come to die.

lines.zh: 我的手一直搭在棺盖上。
lines.en: My hand rests on the lid.
The stillness below suits me better than the shore.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以没有气泡。
lines.en: I don't breathe, so there are no bubbles.
This stretch of seabed is mine to keep.
I have a few left; enough for a while.

lines.zh: 棺材是我的壳，也是我的门。
lines.en: The coffin is my shell and my door.

lines.zh: 谁靠近，我就把盖子掀开。
lines.en: Whoever comes near, I'll lift the lid.

lines.zh: 我的脸沉在水里，很久了。
lines.en: My face has been sunk in water a long time.
I count the light above, slowly.

lines.zh: 我把笼子挪了挪，换个姿势。
lines.en: I shift the cage to change my grip.

lines.zh: 岸上的声音传下来，很闷。
lines.en: Sounds from the shore arrive muffled.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气在水里冒泡。
lines.en: Your breath rises in bubbles.
I'm studying the scales on your armor.

lines.zh: 你身后那只僵尸，是我的。
lines.en: That zombie behind you is mine.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一具还没躺下的尸体。
lines.en: I see a corpse that hasn't lain down yet.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑在水里会慢。
lines.en: Your sword will be slow in water.
I don't need air. You do.

lines.zh: 你越往下，我的优势越大。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the more advantage I have.

lines.zh: 你的光在水里只照三步。
lines.en: Your light reaches only three steps down here.
Don't rush up yet; I have more to say.

lines.zh: 你身上的血，闻起来很新。
lines.en: Your blood smells fresh.
A new mark on the lid.
I retreat half a foot, still unruffled.
You pierced my robe.

lines.zh: 泥沙翻起来，遮了我的眼。
lines.en: Silt swirls up and blinds me.
One of my fingers broke.
The coffin took most of it.
I press the wound and it slowly closes.
Your blows carry some weight.
I hold the cage tighter.
I murmur something low.
Food in the deep? I don't eat.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我连手都不抬。
lines.en: You hold it up; I don't even raise a hand.
Put that away.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，也不是吃这个。
lines.en: When I'm hungry, it isn't that I eat.
You'd feed me underwater?

lines.zh: 这味道在水里散得很快。
lines.en: That scent disperses fast down here.

lines.zh: 我对活人的食物没兴趣。
lines.en: Living food doesn't interest me.
Keep it to catch your breath.

lines.zh: 我不需要这些，我需要你靠近。
lines.en: I don't need that. I need you closer.

lines.zh: 这点东西，抵不上我一只笼子。
lines.en: That's worth less than one of my cages.
You hit the coffin; the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 棺盖是关着的，你推不动。
lines.en: The lid is shut. You can't shift it.

lines.zh: 我在这边，你不必靠那么近。
lines.en: I'm over here; no need to come so close.

lines.zh: 我的袍子缠上你的脚踝。
lines.en: My robe tangles around your ankle.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的棺材不让人。
lines.en: Step back; my coffin doesn't give way.
Touch me and you'll feel cold.
Collisions in water make little sound.

lines.zh: 我没动，是水把我推了过去。
lines.en: I didn't move; the water pushed me.
You're pressing the cage. Get off.
Come closer and the lid opens.
Another one is down here too.
We set our coffins side by side.

lines.zh: 它笼子里的东西，比我凶。
lines.en: The thing in its cage is fiercer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们不来往，只各守一段。
lines.en: We don't visit; we keep our own stretches.

lines.zh: 同族之间，水里不用客套。
lines.en: Between our kind, water leaves no room for courtesy.
It pushes a cage toward me.

lines.zh: 我们并排沉下去，很安静。
lines.en: We sink side by side in silence.
It understands and drifts back.
When we part, no ripple shows.
We'll meet again at the next tide.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，沉到我这。
lines.en: Whatever falls sinks down to me.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，让水把它送来。
lines.en: I don't bend; I let the water bring it.
This pearl has weight.
I tuck it into a seam of the coffin.
Whatever floats down here is mine.

lines.zh: 我捞起来看了看，不认得。
lines.en: I scoop it up and find I don't know it.
Iron rusts in the sea. A pity.
I set it beside the cage.
Done gathering, and I'm still again.
This fell from above.
The cage is aimed at you.
I'll press you to the seabed.
You struck first. Noted.

lines.zh: 我的盖子打开了，你知道意味什么。
lines.en: The lid is open. You know what that means.

lines.zh: 这片海床上的活物，只剩你一个。
lines.en: You're the only living thing left on this seabed.

lines.zh: 我叫的东西，正在游过来。
lines.en: What I called is swimming over.
Your air won't last to shore.
Locked on — right above me.
I'll bring you down.

lines.zh: 你的挣扎，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see your struggle clearly.
You swim up; I raise my gaze after you.
The cage stays above your head.

lines.zh: 你在水里的动作太慢了。
lines.en: Your movements are too slow in water.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你会沉下来的。
lines.en: I needn't chase; you'll sink.
I wait for you to lose that breath.

lines.zh: 上面那些人，已经被我叫走了。
lines.en: The ones above have already been called away.
Your light is dimming.

lines.zh: 我在沙上拖着走，声音很轻。
lines.en: I drag along the sand, barely audible.

lines.zh: 你退到礁石边，礁石后是我。
lines.en: You back to the reef, and I'm behind it.
I keep looking up at you.
I drop the cage onto your head.
The lid shuts; I'm charging.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作很慢，可你躲不开。
lines.en: My arm rises slowly, but you can't dodge.
I press your shoulder down.
The cold water stiffens your limbs.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可你动不了。
lines.en: It isn't heavy, but it holds you.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划开了你的护腕。
lines.en: My nails split your bracer.

lines.zh: 我叫的东西咬住了你的腿。
lines.en: What I called has your leg.
You're being dragged deeper.
The lid opens and I strike.
I rise out of the trench.
The coffin lands first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 深海里多了一盏没有光的灯。
lines.en: One more lightless lamp in the deep.
Someone dived down. I wake.
The water turned cold. That's me.
My cages are still here. Enough.

lines.zh: 我张开手，沙子从指缝漏下去。
lines.en: I open my hand and sand runs through.
At last, something living.
I push the lid open a crack.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的舱口爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a wreck's hatch.
Fire only hisses white steam down here.
I sink faster; the landing makes no sound.
Seawater only sharpens me.

lines.zh: 爆开的水推得我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast wave rolls me over.
A bolt sticks in the coffin wood.
A rune glimmers in the water.
Hungry too long, my movements slow further.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面上，水里全是麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface; the water stings.

lines.zh: 我往更深处掉，那里没有底。
lines.en: I fall deeper, where there is no bottom.
